newsitem.title: USA: Team Rental completes note placements.
newsitem.headline: Team Rental completes note placements.

text.p: Team Rental Group Inc on Tuesday said it completed two private placements, consisting of a $200 million medium-term note facility for fleet financing and an $80 million placement of convertible subordinated notes.
It said proceeds from the medium-term note facility were used to refinance more than half of the vehicles in the company's rental fleet.

Proceeds from the subordinated notes were utilized to provide the required equity enhancement for the medium-term note. It will also use those proceeds to repay non-vehicle debt, to finance certain fleet vehicles and to provide working capital for continued growth.
Team Rental Group owns and operates 13 Budget Rent a Car franchises.
